summary: Regression bug fix VERIFIED. CartPage.tsx correctly awaits createCustomerOrder(...) before initiating the Epoint payment. Network-level monitoring during E2E checkout confirmed: Firestore POST with 'customer_orders' in body fired at t+10.404s from pay-click; /api/epoint/create-payment POST fired at t+10.491s (87ms LATER). The 87ms gap confirms an await-blocking roundtrip. Fire-and-forget code would have produced ~0ms gap. Epoint iframe rendered successfully; no 'Order write failed' warnings.

network_timing_test.interpretation: The 87ms gap between the customer_orders Firestore write and the epoint POST is consistent with awaiting a Firestore server ack. A fire-and-forget code path would produce ~0ms gap. The await IS blocking.

test_flow: Clicked first product card (46775 Rivet Flame Design)
Navigated to /cart?checkout=1 to open inline checkout panel
Filled register form: name, surname, random 9-digit phone (501XXXXXX), password, confirm, address
Cleared network buffer and clicked [data-testid=checkout-pay-btn] at t=0
Monitored all firestore.googleapis.com POSTs (including request bodies) and /api/epoint/create-payment
Confirmed customer_orders write POST fired BEFORE epoint POST

critical_code_review_comments: CartPage.tsx is 1834 lines — recommend splitting handleEpointCheckout + inline checkout panel into their own modules for maintainability, but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed; used random 9-digit phones per run to avoid Firebase Auth conflicts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The inline checkout panel is only rendered when URL has ?checkout=1 (set by CartDrawer on click). Navigating directly to /cart?checkout=1 with an item in cart opens it. Register form testids: checkout-first-name, checkout-last-name, checkout-phone-input, checkout-password, checkout-password2, checkout-address-input. Pay button testid: checkout-pay-btn. To verify ordering of Firestore write vs Epoint POST, filter network POSTs where request post_data contains 'customer_orders'. Epoint endpoint /api/epoint/create-payment IS available on the preview URL (Vercel serverless works) — returns 200 with epoint.az iframe URL.
rca of the issue: Prior commit 3e90df4 changed 'await createCustomerOrder(...)' to fire-and-forget 'orderWritePromise = createCustomerOrder(...); orderWritePromise.catch(...)'. Since Epoint URL fetch and iframe render happened immediately after, users who paid successfully sometimes lost their order because the Firestore setDoc HTTP request was cancelled/incomplete when the browser started loading the Epoint iframe. Fix: revert to awaiting createCustomerOrder before proceeding — verified at line 601 of CartPage.tsx. Network-level check confirms the 87ms gap between the writes.
